title: Store Graphql Kit Surface Tested
description: compose/store (@compose/store): expose kit materialization as clean tested GraphQL interface aligned with compose/rs schema.
summary: Hardened compose-store GraphQL-over-HTTP: is_mutation_request skips fragment definitions so comment+fragment+mutation bodies are classified correctly for the no-install mutation guard.
